# WinVosk

> Offline dictation and voice-to-text for Windows: hold a hotkey, speak, and the
> recognised text is typed at the caret of the window you were typing in.
> Recognition runs locally with Vosk and a speech model; nothing leaves the
> machine. The language is the model's choice — the publisher lists models for
> two dozen languages, and any model dropped into `models\` is picked up
> automatically. The model this repository is verified with is the small Russian
> one.

WinVosk is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Alpha
Cephei or the Vosk project. Vosk is a trademark of its owner, used here to name
the underlying toolkit.

## For agents

If you are setting this up, do not guess. Read the file the task names, use the
pinned versions, and verify with the project's own commands.

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, install, model, own words, verification.
- [docs/instructions/setup.md](docs/instructions/setup.md): the install
  procedure as an explicit sequence, with the traps.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture, the verification bar, and the invariants
  with the reason behind each one. Read before changing code.
- [project.md](project.md): the project context in one page — stack, layout,
  commands.

### Where things come from

- Python packages: `requirements.txt`, exactly five pins. Do not substitute
  versions; `vosk` 0.3.45 is the binding that ships a `cp314` `win_amd64` wheel.
- Speech models: <https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models> — the single source of
  truth for what exists, in which languages, how big and under what license. The
  official archive URL and a Hugging Face mirror are given in README.md; both
  serve the same bytes. Any model in `models\` works; `vosk-model-small-ru-0.22`
  is the verified default.
- Everything else in the repository: original work under Apache-2.0.

### Verify, do not assume

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m compileall -q .\src
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe .\src\run.py --diagnose
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe .\src\winvosk\file_transcribe.py --self-test
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe .\tools\correct_probe.py
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe .\tools\lang_probe.py
```

`--diagnose` must print the expected `base dir` and a real `records from` line;
the probes must print `VERDICT: PASS`. `AGENTS.md` lists what each check proves.
